semiconductor_relevance: High — ZM Semiconductor Equipment specializes in vacuum and precision equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ZM Semiconductor Equipment (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of vacuum-related equipment and precision components for semiconductor manufacturing. The company provides customized solutions and serves both domestic and international markets, emphasizing localized replacement of key auxiliary equipment.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Jinshan, Shanghai, and serves major domestic semiconductor manufacturing and packaging testing enterprises.
